name: Vermont National Country Club
cardNote: Eight internally consistent official tee and combo rows, pars, men’s handicaps, totals, ratings and slopes were read from the club’s course-tour scorecard. Gold/Blue is omitted because the displayed hole values total 6,342 while the page prints 6,292. The generated pack stores men’s ratings where printed; women’s alternate ratings are documented by the official source but are not mixed into the same tee objects. All 18 numbered OSM routes reconcile to the official pars. Retrieved October 28, 2026.
